name: ns-3 smoke, liveness, forgiveness, and DBLP loss checks
notes: The four smoke scripts and the 16-rank trace generation, on the same runtime bundle and node class every other record runs on. Measured at about 4 minutes of simulation locally on four cores; 40 minutes covers a slow node. The run_directory is the whole runs/ tree because the smoke scripts write fixed paths under it.

name: Llama 3 70B congestion pair (seed 31415926)
notes: Designed-2:1 hard condition; seed is the pi chunk '31415926', one of the sixteen consecutive 8-digit chunks of pi (3.14159265...) that form the pre-registered statistical family - taken in order, none screened or discarded (a leading-zero chunk simply parses to a shorter integer). Sixteen paired seeds shrink the standard error of paired p99 deltas to ~sigma/4, resolving the +/-3-4% ECMP path-collision noise floor. Timeout chain, derived from the SLURM walltime (4d20h = 6960 min): per-sim last-resort 396000 s (6600 min) < whole-comparison 6720 min < Actions job ceiling 6900 min < walltime. Wedged arms die in minutes via the transport forward-progress deadline; the wall clocks are backstops, not budgets. Timeout chain: the per-arm simulation cap of 396000 s does not sum to the 6720 min whole-comparison budget across 3 arms, so the walltime is the backstop and the per-arm cap only bounds one wedged arm; revisit both if an arm is added.

name: Regime map 64-rank none direct2 2to1
notes: Cross-binary replicate: this cell is the sr2x fixed-low arm (same seed, 8:4 fabric, direct2, selective repair, p 0.005 everywhere) rerun on the current binary, so its W and DP spans must reproduce the run #117 sr2x fixed-low arm; a drift here is a build regression, not a regime finding. Regime map point: one characterization arm, no comparison. Both selection probabilities sit at the strict bound, so this single run.py invocation is exactly the fixed-low arm a comparison would have produced. The map tests H1 (sustained oversubscription with fan-in), H2 (burst persistence) and H3 (congestion control on) from docs/agents/next-steps-after-run-117.md at once, under selective repair only. Pre-registered estimands: W, burst drain over its serialization floor, DP span at the burst and aftermath steps, trimmed-to-untrimmed DP flow ratio, RTO count, rate-cut count. Budget mirrors the 64-rank sr2x canary, which ran in about 11 h.
